contracts.contract_kind: fresh-install pristine capture, overlay application, and post-materialization verification semantics

declares how planning-side future_preservation becomes verifier review obligations, report shape, and helper-visible doctrine carriers when present

contracts.contract_kind: repo-local gsd-sdk runtime verification and bounded executable repair
contracts.claim_boundary: declares the bounded repo-local recovery path for the gsd-sdk launcher when the discovered shebang target loses readable/executable mode without muting real off-PATH or broader install failures

contracts.contract_kind: transition-side future-preservation carry and state-digest upkeep semantics
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how plan-side future_preservation is reread at phase close, how the four carry buckets are dispositioned, and how the compact Future Carry Forward digest remains explicit in project state

contracts.contract_kind: milestone-boundary long-arc and future-carry reread semantics
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how milestone opening and milestone close reread LONG-ARC and Future Carry Forward, and how still-live carry remains explicit across milestone boundaries instead of thinning into operator memory

contracts.contract_kind: first-read state consumer semantics for accumulated context, future carry, and session continuity
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how the repo-local state snapshot helper keeps decisions, blockers, future-carry buckets, and session continuity explicit for current first-read consumers, and how progress plus resume inherit that carry without relying on reader memory

contracts.contract_kind: upstream spec future-aware notes and first downstream discuss-consumer semantics
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how spec-phase reads long-arc doctrine, writes bounded Future-Aware Notes when materially present, and how discuss-phase inherits that upstream spec contract instead of leaving the spec boundary narrower than the later lifecycle chain

contracts.contract_kind: shared read-packet tier semantics for operator-facing entry and re-entry surfaces
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how required, supporting, and deeper reading tiers keep startup context, route-local widening, and later bounded reread explicit across current operator-facing entry and re-entry workflows without replacing contextual judgment

contracts.contract_kind: shared read-packet tier semantics for initialization, milestone-open, and doc-ingest surfaces with explicit uplift-route separation
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how new-project, new-milestone, and ingest-docs inherit required/supporting/deeper reading tiers, and how existing-project refresh or later repo-local uplift remain explicit route splits instead of being flattened into one blended startup space

contracts.contract_kind: repair and migration follow-through semantics for structural health, format conversion, and later uplift separation
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how health inherits layered read-packet control, keeps structural repair separate from missing-planning routing and later uplift, and how from-gsd2 adds structural validation plus later uplift handoff instead of ending at format conversion alone

contracts.contract_kind: runtime and package update follow-through semantics with layered read-packet control and separate structural-repair versus later-uplift routing
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how update inherits layered read-packet control, keeps runtime/package movement separate from structural planning repair and later repo-local uplift, and how gsd-update preserves that route split instead of flattening runtime currentness into the whole project-entry story

contracts.contract_kind: seed producer and milestone-open consumer follow-through semantics with explicit strengthening-carry preservation and consumption
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how plant-seed preserves strengthening carry in an explicit section, how new-milestone consumes Why This Matters plus Strengthening Carry from matching seeds, and how the gsd-plant-seed wrapper keeps that producer role explicit instead of leaving seed meaning ambient

contracts.contract_kind: ideation-side seed producer convergence semantics with explicit routing into the live plant-seed contract
contracts.claim_boundary: declares how explore routes selected seed outputs through $gsd-plant-seed and the live SEED-NNN-slug contract, and how gsd-explore keeps that current route explicit instead of leaving a legacy inline seed shape live beside the current producer
